headline: LLM agents now mine patents, literature, and single-cell data for biological findings
label: Verified Llm Research Agents
summary: Agentic LLM systems are now extracting bioactivity, enzyme reaction, and single-cell analysis outputs from unstructured sources at scale.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the use of LLM-based agents to convert heterogeneous biomedical sources into structured, checkable outputs. HARVEST applies multi-agent LLMs to USPTO patents, extracting 3.15M bioactivity records from 164,877 documents, adding 967 new targets, and introducing the H-Bench benchmark. zERExtractor pairs a multimodal LLM and deep learning platform with human-in-the-loop curation to pull enzyme-catalyzed reaction data from literature diagrams, tables, and text. CellVoyager shifts the agent role toward analysis, autonomously generating and running scRNA-seq workflows in Jupyter and evaluating them on the 76-study CellBench benchmark. What is new is the pairing of agentic execution with explicit benchmarking, though the items differ in whether verification relies on human oversight or formal evaluation.
